run_evaluate_params: run evaluate_params to simulate a Minitaur robot walking with given motor angle parameters and return the final reward score
run_evaluate_desired_motorAngle_2Amplitu: run evaluate_desired_motorAngle_2Amplitude4Phase to compute 8 joint values using 2 amplitudes and 4 phase offsets for sinusoidal gait
run_evaluate_desired_motorAngle_hop: run evaluate_desired_motorAngle_hop to compute joint values for a hopping gait pattern with configurable amplitude and speed
run_is_fallen: run is_fallen to check if the Minitaur robot has tipped over by comparing its local up vector against the world up axis
run_current_position: run current_position to get the Minitaur robot base position as a numpy array from the PyBullet simulation
